claim.claim-text: 1. A method for configuration of a partition-resistant communication network, comprising:
2. The method of claim 1, further comprising:

storing a plurality of location profiles, wherein each location profile includes at least a geographic location and an associated communication address designator; and executing query on the location database to identify a location profile for the distant computing device and the at least one local computing device where the included communication address designator corresponds to a communication address associated with the respective computing device, wherein the greater message transmission distance is based on the geographic location included in each of the identified location profiles and a geographic location of the processing server.
3. The method of claim 1 or claim 2, wherein the request message is electronically transmitted as a broadcast message using a predefined user datagram protocol (UDP) port,

the broadcast message is transmitted to the at least one local computing device with a first time to live, the broadcast message is transmitted to the distant computing device with a second time to live, and the second time to live has a higher value than the first time to live.
4. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the request message further includes a blockchain network address derived using a public key associated with the processing server.

5. The method of any preceding claim, wherein each of the one or more agreement messages include a communication address associated with the respective computing device, a specified transmission control protocol (TCP) port; and wherein the communication connection to the distant computing device is established via the TCP port specified in the respective agreement message.
6. The method of claim 5, wherein each of the one or more agreement messages further includes a blockchain network address derived using a public key associated with the respective computing device.

7. The method of claim 4, wherein transmissions made by the processing server using the established communication channel are signed using the blockchain network address derived using the public key associated with the processing server.
8. The method of any preceding claim, wherein the greater message transmission distance is at least a predetermined distance from the processing server.
9. The method of claim 8, wherein the predetermined distance is suitable to resist network partitioning due to physical intervention.
10. The method of any preceding claim, including:
11. A system for configuration of a partition-resistance communication network, comprising:

identify one distant computing device and at least one local computing device of the plurality of computing devices, wherein the distant computing device has a greater message transmission distance to the processing server than the at least one local computing device; and establish a communication connection to the distant computing device.
12. The system of claim 11, further comprising:

a location database of the processing server configured to store a plurality of location profiles, wherein each location profile includes at least a geographic location and an associated communication address designator; and the processing device of the processing server configured to execute a query on the location database to identify a location profile for the distant computing device and the at least one local computing device where the included communication address designator corresponds to a communication address associated with the respective computing device, wherein the greater geographic distance is based on the geographic location included in each of the identified location profiles and a geographic location of the processing server.
13. The system of claim 11 or claim 12, wherein the generated request message is electronically transmitted as a broadcast message using a predefined user datagram protocol (UDP) port,

the broadcast message is transmitted to the at least one local computing device with a first time to live, the broadcast message is transmitted to the distant computing device with a second time to live, and the second time to live has a higher value than the first time to live.
14. The system of any of claims 11 to 13, wherein the request message further includes a blockchain network address derived using a public key associated with the processing server.

15. The system of claim 10, wherein each of the one or more agreement messages include a communication address associated with the respective computing device, and a specified transmission control protocol (TCP) port; and Wherein the communication connection to the distant computing device is established via the TCP port specified in the respective agreement message.

16. The system of claim 15, wherein each of the one or more agreement messages further includes a blockchain network address derived using a public key associated with the respective computing device.

17. The system of claim 14, wherein transmissions made by the processing server using the established communication channel are signed using the blockchain network address derived using the public key associated with the processing server.
18. The system of any of claims 11 to 17, wherein the greater message transmission distance is at least a predetermined distance from the processing server.
19. The system of claim 18, wherein the predetermined distance is suitable to resist network partitioning due to physical intervention.
